newsitem.title: GREECE: NEW NATIONAL BANK TIRANA BRANCH OPENS DOORS.
newsitem.headline: NEW NATIONAL BANK TIRANA BRANCH OPENS DOORS.

text.p: State National Bank's new branch in Tirana opened for business on Monday, the bank said in a statement.

The branch at Bulevardi Deshmoret e Kombit, in the city's commercial center, will provide a full range of banking services including drachma and foreign currency deposits, loans and letters of guarantee, foreign currency exchange, and funds transfer.
National Bank's Tirana branch was preceded by another branch in Sofia, Bulgaria while there are plans for a branch in Bucharest, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
